description: This file contains functions and constants related to generating and validating compacted summaries, handling identifiers, and ensuring summary quality within a specific agent's compaction process.

methods.name: wrapUntrustedInstructionBlock
methods.description: Wraps a given text in a prompt data block with a label, respecting maximum character limit.

methods.name: buildCompactionStructureInstructions
methods.description: Builds instructions for summarization, optionally including custom instructions and policies.

methods.name: buildStructuredFallbackSummary
methods.description: Generates a fallback summary with required sections, using previous summary if valid.

methods.name: appendSummarySection
methods.description: Appends a section to an existing summary, handling empty or whitespace-only summaries.

methods.name: extractOpaqueIdentifiers
methods.description: Extracts identifiers such as hex strings, URLs, file paths, and other opaque identifiers from text.

methods.name: auditSummaryQuality
methods.description: Checks if a summary contains all required sections, identifiers, and reflects the latest user ask.
